cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet fluid oozes from the tip of its heads. The taste of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

ability.name: Feather Arrow
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.flavorText: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mounts where they live.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who posses one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: It marches over the land in search of bug Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater so it can dine on them where it's safe.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavorText: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the sky, because wherever they're circling, the ocean sure to be is teeming with fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Brionne
cards.flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards it enemies.

cards.name: Primarina
cards.flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learning from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can't move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it's ever eaten.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

ability.name: Psychic Transfer
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.flavorText: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.flavorText: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokémon takes great care in lapping it up.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.flavorText: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Persian
cards.flavorText: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.

ability.name: Ultra Road
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed make this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Trumbeak
cards.flavorText: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

cards.name: Toucannon
cards.flavorText: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

ability.name: Search the Premises
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent reveal their hand.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

cards.name: Pikipek
cards.flavorText: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses holes for food storage and for nesting.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Litten

cards.name: Popplio

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.flavorText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

ability.name: Aero Trail
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Feather Arrow
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

ability.name: Aero Trail

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

ability.name: Light's End
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Colorless Pokémon.

ability.name: Shadow Hunt
ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of Basic Pokémon in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.flavorText: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

cards.name: Silvally
cards.flavorText: Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

ability.name: Flashing Head
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

cards.name: Shining Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Shining Lugia
cards.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

ability.name: Trade
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

ability.name: Gyro Unit
ability.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

cards.name: Wash Rotom
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like plasma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Gumshoos

cards.name: Mimikyu

cards.name: Xurkitree

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Lycanroc

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's steel spikes are sheathed in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep wounds and severe frostbite as well.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: Possessing a calm demeanor, this Pokémon was revered as a deity incarnate before it was identified as a regional variant of Ninetales.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

ability.name: Dragon Lift
ability.text: Your Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost, except Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

ability.name: Breath of the Leaves
ability.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 50 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

ability.name: Freezing Gaze
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in play, in their hand, and in their discard pile have no Abilities, except for Freezing Gaze.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feel stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma
cards.flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

ability.name: Hydrating Drops

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

ability.name: Hard Coat
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

ability.name: Cursed Body
ability.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Confused.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He was the partner of Tim's father, Harry, who has gone missing. This Pikachu loves the dark coffee at the Hi-Hat Cafe.

ability.name: Perfection
ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX on your Bench or in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Skilled in deduction, he's a self-proclaimed "great detective." His detective hat is his trademark.

ability.name: Elusive Master
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is the last card in your hand, you may play it onto your Bench. If you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Necrozma
cards.flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

ability.name: Troubleshooting

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by Mewtwo to prove that copies can be even more powerful than their originals.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Armored Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: Mewtwo was on a rampage searching for meaning to its existence in this world when Giovanni suppressed and controlled its power.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

ability.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.flavorText: Although it doesn't like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.flavorText: It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.

ability.name: High Density Armor
ability.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 90 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard—so much so, it can't roll its body up into a ball.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy mountain. As it races through the snowfields, it sends up a spray of snow.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.

cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavorText: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.flavorText: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.flavorText: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

ability.name: Aero Trail
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.flavorText: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.flavorText: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.flavorText: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

ability.name: Wonder Tag
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Wonder Tag
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

ability.name: Bloodthirsty Eyes
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Minior
cards.flavorText: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

ability.name: Geotech System
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Psychic or Metal Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.flavorText: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavorText: Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm when they eat Blissey's egg, which is said to be filled with happiness.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.flavorText: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Swellow
cards.flavorText: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

ability.name: Aero Trail
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Wonder Tag
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Psychic or Metal Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Feather Arrow
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavorText: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

ability.name: Light's End
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Colorless Pokémon.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.flavorText: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

ability.name: Shadow Hunt
ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Basic Pokémon in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.flavorText: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.flavorText: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.flavorText: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

ability.name: Restoration
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Restoration
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

ability.name: Secret Spring
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fairy Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of Basic Pokémon in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of Basic Pokémon in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
