cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

cards.name: Shaymin ◇
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

cards.name: Alolan Golem
cards.flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Tapu Koko ◇
cards.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

ability.name: Magic Odds
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks if that damage is exactly 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, 130, 150, 170, 190, 210, 230, or 250.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

ability.name: Twilight Eyes
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: The crystals on Grimer's body are lumps of toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it's not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its Trainer's furnishings and eat up the fragments.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavorText: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.flavorText: It circles in the sky, keeping a keen eye out for Pokémon in a weakened state. Its choicest food is Cubone.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent's movements. It's eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

ability.name: Scar Charge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavorText: Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers to stay put in its nest.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

ability.name: Metal Symbol
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Exeggutor is the pride of the Alolan people. Its image is carved into historical buildings and murals.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

ability.name: Scar Charge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Metal Symbol
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

ability.name: Scar Charge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Metal Symbol
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu
cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

ability.name: Dedechange
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavorText: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

ability.name: Ruler of the Night
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.flavorText: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

ability.name: Fluffy Cotton
ability.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.flavorText: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.flavorText: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

ability.name: Cat Walk
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Cat Walk Ability each turn.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.flavorText: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

ability.name: Force Canceler
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects of your opponent's GX attacks, including damage, done to your Pokémon.

ability.name: Dedechange
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn.

ability.name: Dedechange
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn.

ability.name: Ruler of the Night
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand.

ability.name: Fluffy Cotton
ability.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

ability.name: Cat Walk
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Cat Walk Ability each turn.

ability.name: Force Canceler
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects of your opponent's GX attacks, including damage, done to your Pokémon.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Dedechange
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dedechange Ability each turn.

ability.name: Ruler of the Night
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand.

ability.name: Fluffy Cotton
ability.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

ability.name: Cat Walk
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX was Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Cat Walk Ability each turn.

ability.name: Force Canceler
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all effects of your opponent's GX attacks, including damage, done to your Pokémon.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Sewaddle
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

cards.name: Swadloon
cards.flavorText: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

cards.name: Leavanny
cards.flavorText: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.flavorText: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.flavorText: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

ability.name: Burning Road
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Fire Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.flavorText: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.flavorText: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

cards.name: Basculin
cards.flavorText: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

cards.name: Tirtouga
cards.flavorText: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.

cards.name: Carracosta
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

ability.name: Pure Heart
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.flavorText: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.flavorText: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.flavorText: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

ability.name: Perfection
ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX on your Bench or in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.flavorText: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Wynaut
cards.flavorText: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

ability.name: Power Bind
ability.text: If you have 4 or fewer Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

ability.name: Psychic Zone
ability.text: Don't apply Psychic Weakness when Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take damage from attacks.

ability.name: Psychic Zone
ability.text: Don't apply Psychic Weakness when Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take damage from attacks.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Giratina
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: To attack, this Pokémon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Necrozma
cards.flavorText: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

ability.name: Primal Winds
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

ability.name: Shadow Connection
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Darkness Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

ability.name: Captivating Wink
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand and put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Axew
cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

ability.name: Ultra Conversion
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Ultra Beast card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

cards.name: Munchlax
cards.flavorText: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

cards.name: Audino
cards.flavorText: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Tornadus
cards.flavorText: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.flavorText: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Silvally
cards.flavorText: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.

cards.name: Komala
cards.flavorText: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.

ability.name: Burning Road
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Fire Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

ability.name: Pure Heart
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.

ability.name: Perfection
ability.text: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX on your Bench or in your discard pile. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

ability.name: Power Bind
ability.text: If you have 4 or fewer Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

ability.name: Primal Winds
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

ability.name: Captivating Wink
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may have your opponent reveal their hand and put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto their Bench.

ability.name: Ultra Conversion
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Ultra Beast card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

ability.name: Burning Road
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to become your Active Pokémon, you may move any number of Fire Energy from your other Pokémon to it.

ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX.
