ability.name: Ultra Conversion
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Ultra Beast card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.flavorText: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.flavorText: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Pheromosa
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavorText: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavorText: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Xurkitree
cards.flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

cards.name: Poipole
cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.flavorText: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

cards.name: Celesteela
cards.flavorText: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.flavorText: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

ability.name: Breath of the Leaves
ability.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 50 damage from 1 of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

ability.name: Feather Arrow
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Legendary Ascent
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, move any number of Water Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Freezing Gaze
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in play, in their hand, and in their discard pile have no Abilities, except for Freezing Gaze.

ability.name: Shuriken Flurry
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Extra Energy Bomb
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 5 Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon, except Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX, in any way you like. If you do, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

ability.name: Flashing Head
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

ability.name: Shady Move
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 Pokémon to another Pokémon.

ability.name: Empty Light
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned.

ability.name: Bloodthirsty Eyes
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Twilight Eyes
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Restoration
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. Then, attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Danger Perception
ability.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 100 or less, its attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Slice Off
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Ultra Wall
ability.text: Your Ultra Beasts take 10 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Secret Spring
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fairy Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

ability.name: Gyro Unit
ability.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

ability.name: Aero Trail
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon. If you do, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Wonder Tag
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Shining Vine
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, when you attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to it, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

ability.name: Fragrant Flower Garden
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Lileep
cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.flavorText: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

ability.name: Flaming Shot
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.flavorText: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

ability.name: Dance of Tribute
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dance of Tribute Ability each turn.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.flavorText: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.flavorText: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

ability.name: Dusty Defense
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Anorith
cards.flavorText: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.flavorText: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Throh
cards.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.flavorText: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

ability.name: Smug Face
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's TAG TEAM Pokémon and Ultra Beasts, and by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.flavorText: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.flavorText: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.flavorText: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.flavorText: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

cards.name: Azurill
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.flavorText: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

ability.name: Violent Appetite
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Pokémon from your hand. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.flavorText: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.flavorText: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma
cards.flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavorText: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.flavorText: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, when you attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to it, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.flavorText: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.flavorText: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavorText: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

cards.name: Galarian Rapidash
cards.flavorText: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Munna
cards.flavorText: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.flavorText: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

cards.name: Polteageist
cards.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

ability.name: Watch Over
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.flavorText: It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.flavorText: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.flavorText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Skorupi
cards.flavorText: It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this Pokémon's poison seeps in.

cards.name: Drapion
cards.flavorText: It's so vicious that it's called the Sand Demon. Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Galarian Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.flavorText: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

ability.name: Intrepid Sword
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Dauntless Shield
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

ability.name: Watch Over
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Intrepid Sword
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Dauntless Shield
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX.

ability.name: Intrepid Sword
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Dauntless Shield
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

ability.name: Happy Match
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Applin
cards.flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

cards.name: Applin
cards.flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Appletun
cards.flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.

cards.name: Litwick
cards.flavorText: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

cards.name: Lampent
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

ability.name: Field Runner
ability.text: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka
cards.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

ability.name: Cold Absorption
ability.text: Whenever you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, heal 30 damage from it.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

ability.name: Counterattack Kerzap
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola
cards.flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola
cards.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Hattrem
cards.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

cards.name: Hatterene
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
cards.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

cards.name: Galarian Yamask
cards.flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

cards.name: Galarian Runerigus
cards.flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
