cards.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

ability.name: Watch Over
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Iron Defense Formation
ability.text: All of your Pokémon that have "Falinks" in their name take 20 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: V Transformation
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may choose a Basic Pokémon V from your discard pile and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

ability.name: Soft Wool
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Eternal Zone
ability.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

ability.name: Exciting Stage
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand instead. You can't use more than 1 Exciting Stage Ability each turn.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.flavorText: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.flavorText: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.flavorText: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.flavorText: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.flavorText: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

ability.name: Emperor's Eyes
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Pokémon with a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes).

cards.name: Frillish
cards.flavorText: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.flavorText: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

ability.name: Dummy Doll
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Mimikyu V by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.flavorText: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.flavorText: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.flavorText: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

cards.name: Galarian Slowbro
cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

ability.name: Lustrous Body
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.flavorText: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

ability.name: Exciting Stage
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand instead. You can't use more than 1 Exciting Stage Ability each turn.

ability.name: Emperor's Eyes
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Pokémon with a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes).

ability.name: Emperor's Eyes
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Pokémon with a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes).

ability.name: Dummy Doll
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Mimikyu V by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ability.name: Lustrous Body
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavorText: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.

ability.name: Curative Forest
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.flavorText: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.flavorText: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.flavorText: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.flavorText: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

cards.name: Castform Sunny Form
cards.flavorText: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.flavorText: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cards.name: Cinderace
cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

cards.name: Castform Rainy Form
cards.flavorText: This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.

cards.name: Castform Snowy Form
cards.flavorText: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.flavorText: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

cards.name: Tapu Fini
cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

cards.name: Drizzile
cards.flavorText: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

cards.name: Inteleon
cards.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

cards.name: Rapid Strike Urshifu
cards.flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

ability.name: Reconstitute
ability.text: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.flavorText: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

cards.name: Hattrem
cards.flavorText: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

cards.name: Hatterene
cards.flavorText: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

ability.name: Underworld Door
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
cards.flavorText: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

ability.name: Fighting Instinct
ability.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Pokémon V in play.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.flavorText: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Yamask
cards.flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

cards.name: Galarian Runerigus
cards.flavorText: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

ability.name: Wall of Sand
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

cards.name: Kubfu
cards.flavorText: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Galarian Weezing
cards.flavorText: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.

ability.name: Direflame Wings
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Direflame Wings Ability each turn.

cards.name: Galarian Slowking
cards.flavorText: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

ability.name: Hidden Claw
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Pokémon Tool from a Pokémon (yours or your opponent's).

cards.name: Venipede
cards.flavorText: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.flavorText: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.flavorText: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

cards.name: Single Strike Urshifu
cards.flavorText: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: Even though it doesn't die in the vacuum of space, it can't move around very well in zero gravity.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.

ability.name: Natural Cure
ability.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, remove all Special Conditions from it.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.flavorText: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

cards.name: Kecleon
cards.flavorText: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.flavorText: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.flavorText: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.flavorText: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

ability.name: Reconstitute
ability.text: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.

ability.name: Reconstitute
ability.text: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.

ability.name: Fighting Instinct
ability.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Pokémon V in play.

ability.name: Fighting Instinct
ability.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Pokémon V in play.

ability.name: Wall of Sand
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Direflame Wings
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Direflame Wings Ability each turn.

ability.name: Curative Forest
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Grass Pokémon.

ability.name: Underworld Door
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

ability.name: Underworld Door
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Psychic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

ability.name: Greening Cells
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.flavorText: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Applin
cards.flavorText: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.flavorText: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

ability.name: Fleet-Footed
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

ability.name: Crystal Veil
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VMAX, except any Glaceon VMAX.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.flavorText: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.flavorText: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.name: Regieleki
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

cards.name: Galarian Articuno
cards.flavorText: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

ability.name: Solar Revelation
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached.(Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.flavorText: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

cards.name: Floette
cards.flavorText: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

cards.name: Florges
cards.flavorText: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

ability.name: Dream Gift
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.flavorText: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.flavorText: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.flavorText: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Galarian Zapdos
cards.flavorText: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.flavorText: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.flavorText: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.flavorText: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

cards.name: Galarian Moltres
cards.flavorText: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

ability.name: Dark Signal
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

ability.name: Rubbish Collecting
ability.text: This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to it. If it loses this Ability, discard Pokémon Tools from it until only 1 remains.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

cards.name: Shelgon
cards.flavorText: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

cards.name: Salamence
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

ability.name: Azure Pulse
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Dialga
cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Deino
cards.flavorText: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.flavorText: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.flavorText: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

cards.name: Appletun
cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

ability.name: Skyscraper
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have Special Energy attached.

cards.name: Regidrago
cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.flavorText: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.flavorText: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.flavorText: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.
