ability.text: During your turn, you may heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Phantom Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 7 cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Phantom Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 7 cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Chandelure
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

cards.name: Hisuian Arcanine
cards.flavorText: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

cards.name: Castform
cards.flavorText: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

ability.name: Eerie Beam
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Guardian of Love
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to each of your Pokémon that has any Psychic Energy attached, except any Enamorus V.

ability.name: Dark Asset
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You can't use more than 1 Dark Asset Ability each turn.

ability.name: Eternal Zone
ability.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavorText: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavorText: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.flavorText: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

cards.name: Hisuian Lilligant
cards.flavorText: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.flavorText: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

cards.name: Amoonguss
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

cards.name: Virizion
cards.flavorText: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

ability.name: Needle Line
ability.text: If your Active Chesnaught V is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Radiant Tsareena
cards.flavorText: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.flavorText: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.flavorText: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.flavorText: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.flavorText: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

cards.name: Phione
cards.flavorText: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.flavorText: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

ability.name: Transistor
ability.text: Your Basic Lightning Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Radiant Alakazam
cards.flavorText: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

ability.name: Star Rondo
ability.text: During your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.flavorText: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.flavorText: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult
cards.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

ability.name: Irresistible Force
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Fighting Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.flavorText: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.flavorText: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.flavorText: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.flavorText: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

ability.name: Hard Coat
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.flavorText: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.flavorText: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.flavorText: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

cards.name: Radiant Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Klink
cards.flavorText: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

cards.name: Klang
cards.flavorText: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.flavorText: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

cards.name: Cobalion
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.flavorText: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

ability.name: Legacy Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may discard the top 7 cards of your deck. Then, put up to 2 cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

ability.name: Summoning Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may put up to 2 Colorless Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your discard pile onto your Bench. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Reviving Flame
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, attach up to 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.flavorText: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

cards.name: Archen
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.flavorText: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.flavorText: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

cards.name: Hisuian Braviary
cards.flavorText: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.flavorText: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

ability.name: Needle Line
ability.text: If your Active Chesnaught V is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

ability.name: Irresistible Force
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Fighting Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Reviving Flame
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, attach up to 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.text: Your Basic Lightning Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Star Rondo
ability.text: During your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.text: During your turn, you may discard the top 7 cards of your deck. Then, put up to 2 cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Summoning Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may put up to 2 Colorless Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your discard pile onto your Bench. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Summoning Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may put up to 2 Colorless Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your discard pile onto your Bench. (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavorText: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.flavorText: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

cards.name: Passimian
cards.flavorText: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

cards.name: Druddigon
cards.flavorText: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

ability.name: Exciting Stage
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand instead. You can't use more than 1 Exciting Stage Ability each turn.

ability.name: Lustrous Body
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Azure Pulse
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

ability.name: Skyscraper
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have Special Energy attached.

ability.name: Natural Cure
ability.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, remove all Special Conditions from it.

ability.name: Azure Pulse
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

ability.name: Skyscraper
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have Special Energy attached.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavorText: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.flavorText: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavorText: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.flavorText: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

ability.name: Ivy Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

cards.name: Calyrex
cards.flavorText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

cards.name: Radiant Charizard
cards.flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.flavorText: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.flavorText: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.

ability.name: Instant Charge
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Conversion Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may use this Ability. Discard any number of cards from your hand. Then, draw that many cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

cards.name: Radiant Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.flavorText: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

cards.name: Tapu Lele
cards.flavorText: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

ability.name: Witch's Domain
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from your Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Enamorus
cards.flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.flavorText: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth
cards.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.flavorText: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.flavorText: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.flavorText: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

ability.name: Regal Stance
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 5 cards. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Shield Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may use this Ability. During your opponent's next turn, all of your Pokémon take 100 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes Pokémon that come into play during this turn or during your opponent's next turn.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Azure Pulse
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

ability.name: Azure Pulse
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

ability.name: Skyscraper
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have Special Energy attached.

cards.name: Radiant Eternatus
cards.flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Starly
cards.flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

ability.name: Star Guardian
ability.text: During your turn, if your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. They discard that Pokémon and all attached cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

cards.name: Gumshoos
cards.flavorText: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.flavorText: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.flavorText: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Dubwool
cards.flavorText: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Hisuian Voltorb
cards.flavorText: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.flavorText: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.flavorText: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

cards.name: Mew
cards.flavorText: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.flavorText: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

cards.name: Comfey
cards.flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Hisuian Goodra
cards.flavorText: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.flavorText: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.flavorText: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

ability.name: Ivy Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Fleet-Footed
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

ability.name: Fleet-Footed
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

ability.name: Luminous Sign
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Fleet-Footed
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

ability.name: Protective DNA
ability.text: All of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon VSTAR (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Witch's Domain
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from your Pokémon to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Roar of the Sword
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Wild Style
ability.text: This Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Single Strike, Rapid Strike, and Fusion Strike Pokémon in play.

ability.name: Star Abyss
ability.text: During your turn, you may put up to 2 Item cards from your discard pile into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Moon Cleave Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may put 4 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Two-Faced
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Psychic and Darkness type.

ability.name: Regal Stance
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 5 cards. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Star Guardian
ability.text: During your turn, if your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. They discard that Pokémon and all attached cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Phantom Star
ability.text: During your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 7 cards. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Star Portal
ability.text: During your turn, you may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your discard pile to your Water Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

ability.name: Starbirth
ability.text: During your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaquaval
cards.flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Spidops
cards.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: Pikachu seems excited to be going on an adventure, and so do its new pals, from attention-seeking Sprigatito to laid-back Fuecoco and tidy Quaxly.

ability.name: Tandem Unit
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Dino Cry
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Basic Fighting Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

ability.name: Shivery Chill
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Bouquet Magic
ability.text: You must discard a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

ability.name: Voltaic Float
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This POKéMON's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

ability.name: Infernal Reign
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Chi-Yu
cards.flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

cards.name: Iron Bundle
cards.flavorText: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.flavorText: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Scream Tail
cards.flavorText: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

cards.name: Iron Bundle
cards.flavorText: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

ability.name: Tachyon Bits
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Quaking Demolition
ability.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you must discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

ability.name: Infernal Reign
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Safeguard
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

ability.name: Bouquet Magic
ability.text: You must discard a Basic Grass Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Pikachu with Grey Felt Hat
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches of its cheeks.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Flutter Mane
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

cards.name: Iron Thorns
cards.flavorText: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.flavorText: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.flavorText: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.flavorText: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
cards.flavorText: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ability.name: Crimson Armor
ability.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 80 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Hero's Spirit
ability.text: Put this Pokémon into play only with the effect of Palafin's Zero to Hero Ability.

ability.name: Azure Seas
ability.text: Damage from attacks used by this Pokémon isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Rapid Vernier
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavorText: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.flavorText: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its extremely soft wings make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.

ability.name: Cobalt Command
ability.text: Attacks used by your Future Pokémon, except any Iron Crown ex, do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

ability.name: Snow Sink
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.

ability.name: Overvolt Discharge
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Lightning Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

ability.name: Obliging Heal
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon and have it recover from a Special Condition.

ability.name: Overvolt Discharge
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 3 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Lightning Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

ability.name: Squawk and Seize
ability.text: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.flavorText: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.flavorText: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.flavorText: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Meowscarada
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Spidops ex
cards.flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Smoliv

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Growlithe
