cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

ability.name: Tranquil Flower
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavorText: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavorText: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.flavorText: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.flavorText: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.flavorText: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.flavorText: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

cards.name: Nidoran ♀
cards.flavorText: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.flavorText: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.flavorText: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

ability.name: Expanding Body
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavorText: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.flavorText: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

cards.name: Persian
cards.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavorText: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.flavorText: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavorText: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavorText: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavorText: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.flavorText: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.flavorText: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavorText: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavorText: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavorText: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

cards.name: Muk
cards.flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

cards.name: Shellder
cards.flavorText: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.flavorText: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.flavorText: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.flavorText: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.flavorText: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.flavorText: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavorText: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavorText: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavorText: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.flavorText: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.flavorText: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.flavorText: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavorText: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavorText: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavorText: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavorText: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

ability.name: Voltaic Float
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.flavorText: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.flavorText: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.flavorText: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.flavorText: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

ability.name: Tranquil Flower
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Expanding Body
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

ability.name: Voltaic Float
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

ability.name: Tranquil Flower
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

ability.name: Solid Shell
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Voltaic Float
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Lightning Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.flavorText: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.flavorText: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

ability.name: Evanescent
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.flavorText: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.flavorText: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.flavorText: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Wo-Chien
cards.flavorText: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.flavorText: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.flavorText: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

ability.name: Crimson Armor
ability.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 80 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Iron Moth
cards.flavorText: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

cards.name: Chi-Yu
cards.flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavorText: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they've been given to royalty as gifts.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.flavorText: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.flavorText: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

cards.name: Mantyke
cards.flavorText: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.

cards.name: Palkia
cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.flavorText: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.flavorText: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.flavorText: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.flavorText: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Iron Bundle
cards.flavorText: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Chien-Pao
cards.flavorText: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

cards.name: Elekid
cards.flavorText: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.flavorText: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.flavorText: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Latios
cards.flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.flavorText: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

ability.name: Gold Coffin
ability.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.flavorText: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.flavorText: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.flavorText: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

cards.name: Scream Tail
cards.flavorText: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

ability.name: Tachyon Bits
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.flavorText: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

cards.name: Minior
cards.flavorText: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Naclstack
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Klawf
cards.flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

cards.name: Slither Wing
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

ability.name: Magnetic Absorption
ability.text: Once during your turn, if your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, you may attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ting-Lu
cards.flavorText: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.flavorText: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.flavorText: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

cards.name: Brute Bonnet
cards.flavorText: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Jirachi
cards.flavorText: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

cards.name: Durant
cards.flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

ability.name: Incendiary Song
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 60 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Orthworm
cards.flavorText: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

ability.name: Coin Bonus
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw a card. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, draw 1 more card.

ability.name: Humming Heal
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.flavorText: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavorText: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavorText: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.flavorText: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

cards.name: Whismur
cards.flavorText: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.

cards.name: Loudred
cards.flavorText: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

cards.name: Exploud
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.flavorText: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

ability.name: Solidarity
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon for each of your Tandemaus, Maushold, and Maushold ex in play.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Iron Jugulis
cards.flavorText: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.flavorText: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Toedscruel
cards.flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

cards.name: Iron Moth
cards.flavorText: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

cards.name: Mantyke
cards.flavorText: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.flavorText: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.flavorText: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.flavorText: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.flavorText: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.flavorText: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.flavorText: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

cards.name: Minior
cards.flavorText: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Slither Wing
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Brute Bonnet
cards.flavorText: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

ability.name: Evanescent
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

ability.name: Crimson Armor
ability.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 80 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

ability.name: Gold Coffin
ability.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Tachyon Bits
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

ability.name: Magnetic Absorption
ability.text: Once during your turn, if your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, you may attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Coin Bonus

ability.name: Tachyon Bits
