cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

ability.name: Exploding Energy
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.flavorText: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

ability.name: Protective Mycelium
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

ability.name: Dazzling Gaze
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.flavorText: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon's body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

cards.name: Heat Rotom
cards.flavorText: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

ability.name: Psychic Embrace
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Woobat
cards.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.flavorText: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.flavorText: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Fidough
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Greavard
cards.flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

cards.name: Clobbopus
cards.flavorText: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

cards.name: Grapploct
cards.flavorText: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

ability.name: Quaking Demolition
ability.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you must discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

ability.name: Infernal Reign
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.flavorText: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

ability.name: Toxic Wetland
ability.text: Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.flavorText: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Gholdengo
cards.flavorText: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

ability.name: Squawk and Seize
ability.text: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavorText: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavorText: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Snover
cards.flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.flavorText: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Dolliv
cards.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

cards.name: Arboliva
cards.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

cards.name: Toedscool
cards.flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

cards.name: Capsakid
cards.flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

cards.name: Scovillain
cards.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Armarouge
cards.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.flavorText: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, this Pokémon reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavorText: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.flavorText: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.flavorText: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.flavorText: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.flavorText: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.flavorText: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus
cards.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Abra
cards.flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavorText: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavorText: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

cards.name: Mime Jr.
cards.flavorText: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Klefki
cards.flavorText: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Dachsbun
cards.flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.flavorText: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Flittle
cards.flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

cards.name: Annihilape
cards.flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.flavorText: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Naclstack
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.flavorText: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.flavorText: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.flavorText: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.flavorText: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.flavorText: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.flavorText: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.flavorText: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.flavorText: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.flavorText: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

cards.name: Oinkologne
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.flavorText: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

ability.name: Exploding Energy
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

ability.name: Protective Mycelium
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

ability.name: Dazzling Gaze
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

ability.name: Psychic Embrace
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

ability.name: Dust Field
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't have more than 3 Benched Pokémon. If they have 4 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 3 Pokémon on the Bench. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number.

ability.name: Toxic Wetland
ability.text: Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

ability.name: Quick Search
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Quick Search Ability each turn.

ability.name: Expanding Body
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

ability.name: Squawk and Seize
ability.text: Once during your first turn, you may discard your hand and draw 6 cards. You can't use more than 1 Squawk and Seize Ability during your turn.

cards.name: Wugtrio
cards.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

ability.name: Restart
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand.

ability.name: Psychic Embrace
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Psychic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

ability.name: Infernal Reign
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Shivery Chill
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Tandem Unit
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Cursed Land
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Pokémon in play that have any damage counters on them have no Abilities, except for Pokémon ex.

ability.name: Dino Cry
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Basic Fighting Pokémon in any way you like. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

cards.name: Seedot
cards.flavorText: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

cards.name: Nuzleaf
cards.flavorText: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Shroomish
cards.flavorText: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.

cards.name: Breloom
cards.flavorText: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.flavorText: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.flavorText: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.flavorText: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.flavorText: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.flavorText: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.flavorText: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.flavorText: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.flavorText: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

ability.name: Rapid Vernier
ability.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.flavorText: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Victini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.flavorText: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.flavorText: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.

ability.name: Hustle Play
ability.text: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.flavorText: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle, filling its body with power and changing its form.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

cards.name: Wiglett
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

cards.name: Finizen
cards.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

ability.name: Azure Seas
ability.text: Damage from attacks used by this Pokémon isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavorText: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavorText: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.flavorText: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Iron Hands
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

cards.name: Iron Thorns
cards.flavorText: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.flavorText: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavorText: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavorText: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

cards.name: Latias
cards.flavorText: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.flavorText: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.flavorText: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.flavorText: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.flavorText: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.

cards.name: Scream Tail
cards.flavorText: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

cards.name: Flutter Mane
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

cards.name: Iron Valiant
cards.flavorText: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

cards.name: Iron Valiant
cards.flavorText: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

ability.name: Cobalt Command
ability.text: Attacks used by your Future Pokémon, except any Iron Crown ex, do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Meditite
cards.flavorText: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.

cards.name: Medicham
cards.flavorText: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.flavorText: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

cards.name: Golett
cards.flavorText: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.flavorText: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.flavorText: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.flavorText: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.

cards.name: Great Tusk
cards.flavorText: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

cards.name: Great Tusk
cards.flavorText: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

cards.name: Sandy Shocks
cards.flavorText: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.flavorText: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.flavorText: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

ability.name: Gnawing Curse
ability.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

ability.name: Armor Tail
ability.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Basic Pokémon ex.

cards.name: Roaring Moon
cards.flavorText: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.flavorText: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.flavorText: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

cards.name: Iron Treads
cards.flavorText: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.flavorText: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavorText: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavorText: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

cards.name: Dudunsparce
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.flavorText: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.flavorText: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.flavorText: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

cards.name: Iron Jugulis
cards.flavorText: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

cards.name: Shiftry
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

cards.name: Grotle
cards.flavorText: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.flavorText: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.flavorText: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.flavorText: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

ability.name: Hustle Play
ability.text: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost Colorless less for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

ability.name: Azure Seas
ability.text: Damage from attacks used by this Pokémon isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
