cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.flavorText: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.flavorText: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

ability.name: Excited Turbo
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any Fire Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

ability.name: Multi Adapter
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

ability.name: Swirling Prose
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

ability.name: Diamond Coat
ability.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

ability.name: Shadowy Concealment
ability.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Absol
cards.flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

cards.name: Eternatus
cards.flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

ability.name: Emperor's Stance
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.flavorText: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.flavorText: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

cards.name: Archaludon
cards.flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavorText: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.flavorText: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.flavorText: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.flavorText: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

ability.name: Excited Turbo
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any Fire Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

ability.name: Multi Adapter
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

ability.name: Swirling Prose
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, their new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

ability.name: Emperor's Stance
ability.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)

ability.name: Multi Adapter
ability.text: Each of your Pokémon that has "Rotom" in its name may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached. If this Ability goes away, discard Pokémon Tools from those Pokémon until only 1 remains on each.

cards.name: Erika's Oddish
cards.flavorText: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

cards.name: Erika's Gloom
cards.flavorText: It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

ability.name: Lovely Fragrance
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Erika's Bellsprout
cards.flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Erika's Weepinbell
cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Erika's Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.flavorText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Budew
cards.flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
cards.flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Spidops
cards.flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Ethan's Slugma
cards.flavorText: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

cards.name: Ethan's Magcargo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

ability.name: Golden Flame
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Ethan's Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: N's Darumaka
cards.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

cards.name: N's Darmanitan
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

cards.name: Raboot
cards.flavorText: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavorText: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

cards.name: N's Vanillite
cards.flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

cards.name: N's Vanillish
cards.flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

cards.name: Snom
cards.flavorText: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.flavorText: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

cards.name: Glastrier
cards.flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

ability.name: Resolute Heart
ability.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.flavorText: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.flavorText: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

ability.name: Counterattack Quills
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Iono's Tadbulb
cards.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

ability.name: Electric Streamer
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Iono's Pokémon.

cards.name: Iono's Wattrel
cards.flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Iono's Kilowattrel
cards.flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

ability.name: Fairy Zone
ability.text: The Weakness of each of your opponent's Dragon Pokémon in play is now Psychic. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

cards.name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute
cards.flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
cards.flavorText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

ability.name: Power Saver
ability.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless you have 4 or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

ability.name: Bubble Gathering
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move an Energy from 1 of your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Shuppet
cards.flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

cards.name: Banette
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Hop's Phantump
cards.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Hop's Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Spectrier
cards.flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

cards.name: Munkidori
cards.flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Diglett
cards.flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
cards.flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Cynthia's Gible
cards.flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

cards.name: Cynthia's Gabite
cards.flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

ability.name: Tenacious Body
ability.text: If this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

ability.name: Double Type
ability.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Fighting and Psychic type.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.flavorText: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

cards.name: Okidogi
cards.flavorText: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

ability.name: Shadowy Concealment
ability.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
cards.flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
cards.flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

cards.name: Poochyena
cards.flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone
cards.flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon
cards.flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

cards.name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
cards.flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

ability.name: Counterattacking Crest
ability.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: N's Zorua
cards.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

ability.name: Trade
ability.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

ability.name: Flip the Script
ability.text: Once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Flip the Script Ability each turn.

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.flavorText: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.flavorText: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.flavorText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

ability.name: Sky Transport
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: N's Reshiram
cards.flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

cards.name: N's Zekrom
cards.flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

cards.name: Dreepy
cards.flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

cards.name: Drakloak
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Meowth
cards.flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

cards.name: Larry's Dunsparce
cards.flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.flavorText: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

cards.name: Larry's Starly
cards.flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

cards.name: Larry's Staravia
cards.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Larry's Staraptor
cards.flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

cards.name: Fan Rotom
cards.flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

cards.name: Larry's Rufflet
cards.flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

cards.name: Larry's Braviary
cards.flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

cards.name: Larry's Komala
cards.flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

cards.name: Hop's Cramorant
cards.flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.

cards.name: Terapagos
cards.flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

cards.name: Erika's Tangela
cards.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Budew
cards.flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

cards.name: Ethan's Magcargo
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

cards.name: Numel
cards.flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other’s group.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny’s footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

ability.name: Grand Wing
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 4 cards.

ability.name: Sniper's Eye
ability.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

ability.name: Sky Hunt
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

ability.name: Shell Spikes

ability.name: Wash Out
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Water Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Tundra Wall

ability.name: Fighting Roar
ability.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this Pokémon can evolve during your first turn or the turn you play it.

ability.name: Luminous Wing
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Scent Collection
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

ability.name: Stone Arms
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Fighting Pokémon.

ability.name: Tyrannically Gutsy
ability.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +150 HP.

ability.name: Infinite Shadow
ability.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard all attached cards.)

ability.name: Last-Ditch Catch
ability.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Ability that has "Last-Ditch" in its name each turn.

ability.name: Sky Hunt
ability.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

ability.name: Tundra Wall
ability.text: All of your Pokémon that have any Water Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack.

ability.name: Sniper's Eye
ability.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

ability.name: Luminous Wing
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

ability.name: Last-Ditch Catch

Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Ability that has "Last-Ditch" in its name each turn.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.flavorText: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.flavorText: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.flavorText: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavorText: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.flavorText: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle filling its body with power and changing its form.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

ability.name: Mortal Shuriken
ability.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may discard a Basic Water Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.flavorText: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.flavorText: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavorText: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavorText: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavorText: Donphan is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavorText: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokemon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.flavorText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokemon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.flavorText: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Metang
cards.flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

ability.name: Metal Road
ability.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Move any amount of Metal Energy from your other Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.flavorText: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.flavorText: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.flavorText: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.flavorText: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: These Pokemon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

ability.name: Smooth Coat
ability.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
